notes: Pre-load Roblox connection-error recovery. Telemetry v2.3 begins error detection before game.Loaded and listens to GuiService.ErrorMessageChanged/GetErrorCode in addition to RobloxPromptGui ErrorPrompt, covering Connection Failed / Error Code 2 and similar placelaunch/connect failures that can appear before the experience finishes loading. Error code 285 remains ignored. Target-place waits now abort immediately when a telemetry error event is present, and a PC-side pre-game-stall fallback restarts/rejoins when PlaceId remains unknown and telemetry is inactive past the grace period.
